question: Total revenue from completed orders.
llm_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';
trusted_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

question: Number of customers in each country.
llm_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.country;
trusted_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country;

question: Completed revenue by month.
llm_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(order_total) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY month;
trusted_sql: SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY month;

question: Top 3 customers by completed revenue, with their revenue.
llm_sql: SELECT customer_id, ROUND(total, 2) FROM (SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' GROUP BY customer_id) ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 3;
trusted_sql: SELECT o.customer_id, ROUND(SUM(o.amount), 2) AS rev FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Customers who have never placed an order.
llm_sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;
trusted_sql: SELECT c.customer_id FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

question: Average value of a completed order.
trusted_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

question: The 5 most recent orders.
llm_sql: SELECT TOP 5 order_id, order_date FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC;
trusted_sql: SELECT order_id, order_date FROM orders ORDER BY order_date DESC, order_id DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Number of refunded orders per country.
llm_sql: SELECT country, COUNT(order_id) FROM orders JOIN customers USING (customer_id) WHERE status = 'refunded' GROUP BY country;
trusted_sql: SELECT c.country, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'refunded' GROUP BY c.country;
